d: We are looking for enthusiastic and results-driven Telesales Agents to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for generating sales through outbound calls, promoting telecom products and services, achieving sales targets, and delivering an excellent customer experience.
Handle outbound calls to assigned leads and promote products and services.
Generate sales by offering mobile plans, internet packages, and value-added services.
Achieve daily and monthly sales targets (leads, conversions, revenue)
Identify customer needs and recommend suitable products and service packages
Upsell and cross-sell products and services to maximize sales opportunities
Ensure effective follow-up on leads and maintain accurate customer records and sales updates in the CRM system
Handle customer inquiries and objections professionally to convert opportunities into sales
Adhere to call quality standards, scripts, and compliance requirements
Maintain high productivity levels, including connected calls, talk time, and adherence to work schedules
Stay updated on product offerings, promotions, pricing plans, and market developments
Deliver excellent customer service while ensuring a positive customer experience throughout the sales process
q: Minimum 1 year of experience in telesales, call center sales, or direct sales.
Previous telecommunications sales experience is required.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to work in a target-driven and fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in using CRM systems and computer applications.
Strong customer service and relationship management skills.
